cells.value: National Agro-Productivity System (NAPS) — billed as Nigeria's first national crop-monitoring platform powered by satellite imagery and AI (5-day-refresh imagery, automatic farm identification, real-time yield/land-use/food-security intelligence): MoU signed July 2026 on behalf of the Federal Government by Deputy Chief of Staff to the President Sen. Ibrahim Hassan Hadejia with OCP Africa and Ground Truth Analytics, at Mohammed VI Polytechnic University, Ben Guerir, Morocco. Phased rollout: pilot in 1 state -> 3 states -> 15 priority states. Press reporting adds that the framework was approved by the National Council on Agriculture and Food Security in Nov 2024 and had been piloted across 13 states covering 250,000+ farmers before the formal agreement (single-outlet claim, unverified). Private AI deployments (e.g. IITA/CGIAR AKILIMO advisory) operate but Nigeria-specific verified detail is thin.

cells.value: General cross-sector AI/automated-decision safeguards adopted and in force; nothing agriculture-specific. NDPC General Application and Implementation Directive (GAID) 2025 under NDPA 2023 (document dated 20 Mar 2025; law-firm commentary gives effect from 19 Sep 2025): Art. 28(3) makes a DPIA mandatory for profiling and 'automated decision-making with legal or similar significant effects'; Art. 35 recognises interoperable best-practice measures including 'Automated Decision Making' and 'Deployment of Artificial Intelligence'; Art. 43 imposes obligations on controllers/processors deploying AI/IoT/blockchain; Art. 44(3) directs benchmarking against the UN Resolution on AI and requires refraining from/ceasing ET systems incompatible with human-rights law. No agriculture-sector consent or farmer-data-rights instrument found (consistent with the Absent ag-data-governance framework, 4.5).

cells.search_trail: Brave search for GAID 2025 AI provisions -> official NDPC PDF downloaded and text-searched (hits at Arts. 28, 35, 43, 44 verified verbatim) -> law-firm commentaries for effective date -> no ag-specific instrument found via FMAFS/NDPC searches. Access 2026-08-22.
cells.quality_evidence: Legally operative directive issued by the statutory regulator (NDPC) under NDPA 2023; prior pass documents active NDPC enforcement of the parent Act (1,368 compliance notices, 2025).
cells.scale_evidence: No evidence yet of the AI-specific articles being enforced, and none in an agricultural context.
cells.notes: DIVERGENCE from prior desk pass: prior recorded 'NDPA general consent basis; no ag/AI-specific provisions' — GAID 2025 materially updates this: explicit AI/ADM provisions now exist beyond the general law (cross-sector), while agriculture-specific provisions remain Absent. AI-prerequisite reading: Present-general/narrow — general AI safeguards adopted; ag-tailored consent/data-rights still missing.
cells.protocol_issues: Indicator definition ambiguity: 'Ag/AI-specific ... beyond the general DP law' — GAID is AI-specific but sector-general; recorded as Adopted with the ag-specific layer Absent. Effective-date (19 Sep 2025) is sourced from law-firm commentary (T5), not located in the GAID text itself.
